7V2L: Bani of Guru Nanak Dev ji in Raag Dhanasri: 'Aarti'.
7BV5: Akal Purakh is one, and is met by the Satguru's grace.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
YHM4: Gagan = sky. Gagan mai = gagan-may, made of sky, the whole sky. Rav = sun. Dipak = lamps. Janak = as if, like.
The whole sky is (as it were) the tray; the sun and moon are the lamps (in this tray); the hosts of stars are the pearls placed (in the tray).
In the bowl of the sky, the sun and moon are the lamps; the stars in the constellations are the pearls.
In the sky's salver, the sun and the moon are the lamps and the stars with their orbs, are the studded pearls.
The sky is the tray; in it the moon and sun are the lamps; the hosts of stars are the pearls set in it.
ZPKF: Malanalo = {malay-anal} the breeze from the Malay mountains (anal = air). Because sandalwood grows on the Malay mountains, the breeze from there is fragrant. The Malay range is in the south of India. Banrai = vegetation. Phoolant = is giving flowers. Joti = the Prabhu whose form is light. ||1||
The breeze from the Malay mountains is, as it were, the incense (burning); the wind is waving the whisk; all the vegetation is giving flowers (for the aarti) of the Prabhu whose form is light. ||1||
The fragrance of sandalwood is the incense, the wind is the fan, and all the vegetation are flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||
The fragrance of sandal wood make Your incense, wind Your fan and all the vegetation Yours flowers, O Luminous Lord.
Malay is the name of the mountain of sandalwood; the smoke of the fire that caught in it is the incense; the wind waves the whisk; all the vegetation has blossomed. ||1||
H8XQ: Bhavkhandna = O destroyer of birth and death!
O destroyer of the birth and death of beings! What a beautiful aarti of Yours is taking place (in creation)!
What a beautiful lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of fear, this is Your Aartee, Your worship service.
What a beautiful worship with lamps is being performed? Such is Yours adoration O Lord, the Destroyer of dread.
And, O Light! O Bhavkhandna! These are the things of Your aarti, which is taking place openly. What aarti could be greater than this?
BC9A: Anhata = {an-hat} that which sounds without being struck, unbroken. Sabad = sound, the current of life. Bheri = drum, kettledrum. ||1||Rahau||
The unbroken current of life (pulsing in all beings) is, as it were, the drums sounding for Your aarti. ||1||Rahau||
The sound current of the Shabad is the sounding of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||
The celestial strain is the sounding of template drums. Pause.
The Bani that has come from the mouths of people absorbed in the One — this is the unbroken drum sounding. ||1||Rahau||
PCMS: Sahas = thousands. Tav = Your. Nan = none. Tohi kau = for You, Your, to You. Moorat = form. Nana = none. Tohi = Your.
(Pervading all beings,) You have thousands of eyes; (yet, being formless, O Prabhu,) You have no eyes. You have thousands of forms, yet You have no form at all.
Thousands are Your eyes, and yet You have no eyes. Thousands are Your forms, and yet You have not even one form.
Thousands are Yours eyes, yet you have no eye. Thousands are Yours forms, yet You have not even one.
In the manifest form You have thousands of eyes; in the unmanifest, not one. In the manifest there are thousands of forms; in the unmanifest, not a single form.
TQKZ: Pad = feet. Bimal = clean. Gandh = nose. Iv = like this. Chalat = wonder, marvellous play. ||2||
You have thousands of beautiful feet, yet (being formless) You have not one foot. You have thousands of noses, yet You are without a nose. Such wonders of Yours have left me amazed. ||2||
Thousands are Your lotus feet, and yet You have no feet. Without a nose, thousands are Your noses. I am enchanted with Your play! ||2||
Thousands are Yours holy feet, yet You have not one foot. Thousands are Yours noses and yet You are without a nose. I am bewitched by these plays of Yours.

In the manifest there are thousands of feet; O Pure One! In Your unmanifest form there is no foot at all. In the unmanifest You are without the nose that takes in scent; in the manifest there are thousands of noses. Seeing such marvels of Yours, my understanding has been enchanted. ||2||
2M6Y: Jot = light, radiance. Soi = that Prabhu.
The light of that one Parmatma alone is at work in all beings.
The Divine Light is within everyone; You are that Light.
Among all there is light and that light are You.
O Light! The light that is in all is Yours alone.
FATR: Tis kai chanan = by that Prabhu's light.
By the radiance of that light there is light (understanding) in all beings.
Yours is that Light which shines within everyone.
By His Light, the light shines within all the souls.
By the light of that Light of Yours, all the senses are lit.
YYXE: But knowledge of this light comes only through the Guru's teaching (through the Guru one comes to understand that Parmatma's light is within everyone).
By the Guru's Teachings, this Divine Light is revealed.
By Guru's teaching the Divine light becomes manifest.
But that (jot) Light of Yours becomes manifest through the Satguru's (sakhi) teaching.
7EWZ: The aarti (of this all-pervading light) is this: that whatever is happening in His will should seem good to the being (walking in the Prabhu's will is doing the Prabhu's aarti). ||3||
That which pleases the Lord is the true worship service. ||3||
Whatever pleases Him, that is His real worship.
Whatever deed of that being pleases You becomes aarti; or, the aarti that pleases You is accepted.
ZWNJ: Makrand = the dust inside flowers {pollen dust}, the nectar of flowers. Mano = mind. Anadino = every day. Mohi = to me. Aahi = is, remains.
O Hari! My mind longs for the nectar of the lotus flowers that are Your feet; every day I thirst for this very nectar.
My soul is enticed by the honey-sweet lotus feet of the Lord; night and day, I thirst for them.
My soul is bewitched by the honey of the lotus feet of God and, night and day, I am thirsty for them.
O Hari! Our mind, the bumblebee, is greedy for the dust of Your lotus feet, and night and day the thirst goes on.
8NR3: Sarang = the rainbird. Ja te = by which. Terai nam = in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||
Give me, Nanak the rainbird, the water of Your grace, by (the blessing of) which I may stay settled in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||
Bless Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, with the water of Your Mercy, that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||
Bless Nanak, the pied cuckoo, with the Nectar of Yours mercy, so that he may have an abode in Your Name, O Lord.

Sri Guru ji says: in Your grace, give me, the rainbird, the water that is the repeating of the Name — or the water that is grace — by which I may dwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9|| ☬ He tells of receiving the Name through the Guru's teaching, and of the Guru's greatness:
